description: Source code for the ProxyClientSocket class, handling HTTP proxy socket operations including building tunnel requests, handling proxy authentication challenges, and sanitizing proxy authentication headers.

classes.name: ProxyClientSocket
classes.description: Handles HTTP proxy client socket operations, including building tunnel requests, managing proxy authentication, and sanitizing headers.

methods.name: BuildTunnelRequest
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP CONNECT request for establishing a tunnel through a proxy.

methods.name: HandleProxyAuthChallenge
methods.description: Handles proxy authentication challenges using the provided HttpAuthController.

methods.name: SanitizeProxyAuth
methods.description: Removes unnecessary or sensitive headers from the proxy response to sanitize authentication headers.

methods.name: SetStreamPriority
methods.description: Sets the stream priority for the proxy client socket.
